title: Boki 3級: foundations to 未収入金・未払金

questions.q: Which of the following accounts is classified as a liability (負債)?
opts: 売掛金 (Accounts receivable)
買掛金 (Accounts payable)
備品 (Equipment)
資本金 (Capital)
questions.ex: 買掛金 is an obligation to pay a supplier, so it is a liability. 売掛金 and 備品 are assets, and 資本金 is net assets (純資産).

questions.q: A business has total assets (資産) of 800,000 yen and total liabilities (負債) of 300,000 yen. What is its capital (純資産・資本)?
questions.ex: Assets = Liabilities + Capital, so Capital = 800,000 - 300,000 = 500,000.

questions.q: The owner starts a business by contributing 1,000,000 yen in cash. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 現金 (Cash) 1,000,000 / Cr 資本金 (Capital) 1,000,000
Dr 資本金 (Capital) 1,000,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 1,000,000
Dr 現金 (Cash) 1,000,000 / Cr 借入金 (Loans payable) 1,000,000
Dr 現金 (Cash) 1,000,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 1,000,000
questions.ex: Cash (an asset) increases on the debit side, and the owner's contribution increases 資本金 on the credit side.

questions.q: Which statement about the debit (借方) and credit (貸方) rules is correct?
opts: An increase in an asset is recorded on the credit side.
An increase in revenue (収益) is recorded on the debit side.
A decrease in a liability is recorded on the debit side.
An increase in an expense (費用) is recorded on the credit side.
questions.ex: Liabilities increase on the credit side, so a decrease goes on the debit side. Assets and expenses increase on the debit side; revenue increases on the credit side.

questions.q: Using the three-account method (三分法), the company buys merchandise for 200,000 yen on account (掛け). Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 商品 (Merchandise) 200,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 200,000
Dr 仕入 (Purchases) 200,000 / Cr 未払金 (Other payables) 200,000
Dr 仕入 (Purchases) 200,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 200,000
Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 200,000 / Cr 仕入 (Purchases) 200,000
questions.ex: Under 三分法, buying merchandise is debited to 仕入, and an unpaid amount for merchandise is credited to 買掛金 (未払金 is for non-merchandise items).

questions.q: Which set of three accounts is used to record merchandise transactions under the three-account method (三分法)?
opts: 商品・売上原価・売上
仕入・売上・繰越商品
仕入・売上・商品売買益
商品・仕入・売掛金
questions.ex: 三分法 splits merchandise records into 仕入 (purchases), 売上 (sales) and 繰越商品 (inventory carried forward).

questions.q: The company sells merchandise for 300,000 yen, receiving 100,000 yen in cash with the rest on account. Which journal entry is correct (三分法)?
opts: Dr 現金 (Cash) 100,000, 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 200,000 / Cr 商品 (Merchandise) 300,000
Dr 現金 (Cash) 100,000, 未収入金 (Other receivables) 200,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 300,000
Dr 売上 (Sales) 300,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 100,000, 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 200,000
Dr 現金 (Cash) 100,000, 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 200,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 300,000
questions.ex: Sales revenue is credited to 売上 for the full 300,000; the cash part is debited to 現金 and the unpaid part from merchandise sales goes to 売掛金.

questions.q: Under 三分法, the company sells merchandise that cost 60,000 yen for 90,000 yen on account. What amount is credited to 売上 (Sales)?
questions.ex: Under 三分法, 売上 is recorded at the selling price (90,000); the cost and profit are not separated at the time of sale.

questions.q: Of the merchandise bought on account last week, 30,000 yen worth was defective and returned to the supplier. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 仕入 (Purchases) 30,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 30,000
Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 30,000 / Cr 仕入 (Purchases) 30,000
Dr 売上 (Sales) 30,000 / Cr 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 30,000
Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 30,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 30,000
questions.ex: A purchase return (仕入戻し) reverses the original purchase: 買掛金 decreases (debit) and 仕入 decreases (credit).

questions.q: The company sells merchandise for 200,000 yen and the customer pays by credit card. The card company's fee is 2% of the sale and is recorded at the time of sale. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr クレジット売掛金 (Credit card receivables) 200,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 200,000
Dr 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 196,000, 支払手数料 (Fees paid) 4,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 200,000
Dr クレジット売掛金 (Credit card receivables) 196,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 196,000
Dr クレジット売掛金 (Credit card receivables) 196,000, 支払手数料 (Fees paid) 4,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 200,000
questions.ex: Sales are recorded at the full 200,000; the 2% fee (4,000) is 支払手数料, and the net 196,000 owed by the card company is クレジット売掛金.

questions.q: In Boki 3級, which of the following received items is recorded in the 現金 (Cash) account?
opts: A promissory note (約束手形) received from a customer
A revenue stamp (収入印紙) purchased
A check issued by another company (他人振出小切手)
A check the company itself issued earlier (自己振出小切手)
questions.ex: Checks drawn by others can be cashed immediately, so they are treated as 現金. A returned own check goes back to 当座預金.

questions.q: The company sells merchandise for 80,000 yen and receives a check issued by the customer. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 現金 (Cash) 80,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 80,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 80,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 80,000
Dr 受取手形 (Notes receivable) 80,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 80,000
Dr 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 80,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 80,000
questions.ex: A check drawn by another party (他人振出小切手) is treated as cash, so 現金 is debited, not 当座預金 (unless it is deposited immediately).

questions.q: The cash book balance is 50,000 yen, but the actual cash on hand is 47,000 yen. The cause is not yet known. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 現金 (Cash) 3,000 / Cr 現金過不足 (Cash over and short) 3,000
Dr 雑損 (Miscellaneous loss) 3,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 3,000
Dr 現金過不足 (Cash over and short) 3,000 / Cr 雑益 (Miscellaneous gain) 3,000
Dr 現金過不足 (Cash over and short) 3,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 3,000
questions.ex: Cash is short by 3,000, so the book balance is reduced (credit 現金) and the unexplained difference is parked in 現金過不足 until the cause is found.

questions.q: A cash shortage of 5,000 yen was previously debited to 現金過不足. Later, 3,000 yen was found to be an unrecorded payment of 通信費 (Communication expense). At year-end, the rest is still unexplained. Which entry is correct for the unexplained remainder at year-end?
opts: Dr 現金過不足 (Cash over and short) 2,000 / Cr 雑益 (Miscellaneous gain) 2,000
Dr 雑損 (Miscellaneous loss) 5,000 / Cr 現金過不足 (Cash over and short) 5,000
Dr 雑損 (Miscellaneous loss) 2,000 / Cr 現金過不足 (Cash over and short) 2,000
Dr 雑損 (Miscellaneous loss) 2,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 2,000
questions.ex: The remaining debit balance of 5,000 - 3,000 = 2,000 is a shortage, so it is moved to 雑損 and the 現金過不足 account is closed by crediting it.

questions.q: The company pays 120,000 yen of its accounts payable by issuing a check. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 120,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 120,000
Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 120,000 / Cr 当座預金 (Checking account) 120,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 120,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 120,000
Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 120,000 / Cr 支払手形 (Notes payable) 120,000
questions.ex: Issuing a check draws on the checking account, so 当座預金 is credited, and 買掛金 decreases on the debit side.

questions.q: The company collects 50,000 yen of accounts receivable and receives a check that the company itself had issued earlier (自己振出小切手). Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 50,000 / Cr 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 50,000
Dr 現金 (Cash) 50,000 / Cr 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 50,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 50,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 50,000
Dr 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 50,000 / Cr 当座預金 (Checking account) 50,000
questions.ex: When the company's own check comes back, the earlier reduction of 当座預金 is cancelled, so 当座預金 is debited instead of 現金.

questions.q: At year-end, the 当座預金 (Checking account) has a credit balance of 150,000 yen because of an overdraft under an overdraft agreement. Which reclassification entry is correct?
opts: Dr 当座借越 (Bank overdraft) 150,000 / Cr 当座預金 (Checking account) 150,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 150,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 150,000
Dr 当座借越 (Bank overdraft) 150,000 / Cr 借入金 (Loans payable) 150,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 150,000 / Cr 当座借越 (Bank overdraft) 150,000
questions.ex: Debiting 当座預金 brings its credit balance to zero, and the overdraft is shown as a liability by crediting 当座借越.

questions.q: The 当座預金 (Checking account) balance is 80,000 yen and the company has an overdraft agreement with a limit of 300,000 yen. It pays 200,000 yen of accounts payable by check. What is the amount of the overdraft (当座借越) after the payment?
questions.ex: The payment exceeds the balance by 200,000 - 80,000 = 120,000, which is the overdraft (within the 300,000 limit).

questions.q: Under the imprest system (定額資金前渡法), the petty cashier reports payments of 旅費交通費 (Travel expense) 4,000, 通信費 (Communication expense) 2,500 and 消耗品費 (Supplies expense) 1,500. The accountant replenishes the fund immediately by check. Which combined journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 旅費交通費 4,000, 通信費 2,500, 消耗品費 1,500 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 8,000
Dr 旅費交通費 4,000, 通信費 2,500, 消耗品費 1,500 / Cr 当座預金 (Checking account) 8,000
Dr 小口現金 (Petty cash) 8,000 / Cr 当座預金 (Checking account) 8,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 8,000 / Cr 旅費交通費 4,000, 通信費 2,500, 消耗品費 1,500
questions.ex: The report reduces 小口現金 by 8,000 and the check replenishment increases it by 8,000, so those cancel out; the expenses are debited and 当座預金 is credited.

questions.q: A petty cash fund is kept at 30,000 yen under the imprest system. During the week, the cashier spent 21,400 yen. How much is replenished at the end of the week?
questions.ex: Under the imprest system the amount replenished equals the amount spent (21,400), which restores the fund to 30,000.

questions.q: The company buys merchandise for 250,000 yen and pays by issuing a promissory note (約束手形). Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 仕入 (Purchases) 250,000 / Cr 受取手形 (Notes receivable) 250,000
Dr 仕入 (Purchases) 250,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 250,000
Dr 仕入 (Purchases) 250,000 / Cr 支払手形 (Notes payable) 250,000
Dr 支払手形 (Notes payable) 250,000 / Cr 仕入 (Purchases) 250,000
questions.ex: Issuing a promissory note creates an obligation to pay, so 支払手形 (a liability) is credited.

questions.q: A promissory note held by the company for 180,000 yen reaches maturity and the amount is deposited into the company's checking account. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 180,000 / Cr 支払手形 (Notes payable) 180,000
Dr 受取手形 (Notes receivable) 180,000 / Cr 当座預金 (Checking account) 180,000
Dr 現金 (Cash) 180,000 / Cr 受取手形 (Notes receivable) 180,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 180,000 / Cr 受取手形 (Notes receivable) 180,000
questions.ex: Settlement of a note receivable removes 受取手形 (credit), and the money goes into 当座預金 (debit).

questions.q: To settle 90,000 yen of accounts payable, the company agrees to the creation (発生記録) of an electronically recorded obligation. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 90,000 / Cr 電子記録債務 (Electronically recorded obligations) 90,000
Dr 電子記録債務 (Electronically recorded obligations) 90,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 90,000
Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 90,000 / Cr 電子記録債権 (Electronically recorded receivables) 90,000
Dr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 90,000 / Cr 支払手形 (Notes payable) 90,000
questions.ex: The payable is converted into an electronic obligation: 買掛金 decreases (debit) and 電子記録債務, a liability, increases (credit).

questions.q: How is 電子記録債権 (Electronically recorded receivables) classified?
opts: Liability (負債)
Asset (資産)
Revenue (収益)
Net assets (純資産)
questions.ex: 電子記録債権 is a right to receive money, like 受取手形 or 売掛金, so it is an asset.

questions.q: The company borrows 1,000,000 yen from a bank, and the money is deposited into its checking account. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 1,000,000 / Cr 貸付金 (Loans receivable) 1,000,000
Dr 借入金 (Loans payable) 1,000,000 / Cr 当座預金 (Checking account) 1,000,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 1,000,000 / Cr 借入金 (Loans payable) 1,000,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 1,000,000 / Cr 資本金 (Capital) 1,000,000
questions.ex: Borrowing creates a liability, so 借入金 is credited; the deposit increases 当座預金 on the debit side.

questions.q: The company lends 600,000 yen for 6 months at an annual interest rate of 3%. Interest is received together with the principal at maturity. How much interest is received?
questions.ex: Interest = 600,000 x 3% x 6/12 = 9,000. 18,000 would be a full year's interest.

questions.q: The company borrows 500,000 yen from a bank by issuing a promissory note. Interest of 6,000 yen is deducted in advance and the net amount is deposited into the checking account. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 494,000, 支払利息 (Interest expense) 6,000 / Cr 手形借入金 (Notes payable for borrowings) 500,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 494,000, 支払利息 (Interest expense) 6,000 / Cr 支払手形 (Notes payable) 500,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 494,000 / Cr 手形借入金 (Notes payable for borrowings) 494,000
Dr 当座預金 (Checking account) 506,000 / Cr 手形借入金 (Notes payable for borrowings) 500,000, 受取利息 (Interest income) 6,000
questions.ex: A note issued for borrowing money is recorded as 手形借入金 (not 支払手形, which is for trade), at the full 500,000; the deducted 6,000 is 支払利息.

questions.q: The company lends 300,000 yen in cash to a business partner and receives a promissory note from the borrower. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 受取手形 (Notes receivable) 300,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 300,000
Dr 現金 (Cash) 300,000 / Cr 手形貸付金 (Notes receivable for loans) 300,000
Dr 手形貸付金 (Notes receivable for loans) 300,000 / Cr 手形借入金 (Notes payable for borrowings) 300,000
Dr 手形貸付金 (Notes receivable for loans) 300,000 / Cr 現金 (Cash) 300,000
questions.ex: A note received for lending money is recorded as 手形貸付金 (not 受取手形, which is for trade), and the cash paid out is credited.

questions.q: The company buys a delivery truck for 1,800,000 yen, with payment due at the end of next month. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 車両運搬具 (Vehicles) 1,800,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 1,800,000
Dr 仕入 (Purchases) 1,800,000 / Cr 買掛金 (Accounts payable) 1,800,000
Dr 車両運搬具 (Vehicles) 1,800,000 / Cr 未払金 (Other payables) 1,800,000
Dr 車両運搬具 (Vehicles) 1,800,000 / Cr 未収入金 (Other receivables) 1,800,000
questions.ex: The truck is not merchandise, so the unpaid amount is 未払金 rather than 買掛金, and the truck is debited to 車両運搬具.

questions.q: The company sells unused land with a book value of 2,000,000 yen for 2,000,000 yen. The proceeds will be received next month. Which journal entry is correct?
opts: Dr 未収入金 (Other receivables) 2,000,000 / Cr 土地 (Land) 2,000,000
Dr 売掛金 (Accounts receivable) 2,000,000 / Cr 土地 (Land) 2,000,000
Dr 未収入金 (Other receivables) 2,000,000 / Cr 売上 (Sales) 2,000,000
Dr 土地 (Land) 2,000,000 / Cr 未払金 (Other payables) 2,000,000
questions.ex: Land is not merchandise, so the amount to be collected is 未収入金, not 売掛金, and the land (an asset) is removed with a credit.
